parent_objective: run full generated-profile Stage B smoke after representative Stage A training plumbing passes
blocked_by: Stage A passed but the remaining L2 windows and L3_reset_control have not run train-loop smoke
supersedes: assuming all generated profiles train because representative profiles passed
invalidates: starting fair comparison pilot before all generated profiles complete smoke training

public_gates: M1197 may run bounded Stage B PPO training smoke only
M1197 may train all eight generated profiles for smoke-scale plumbing only
M1197 must not use private holdout
M1197 must not tune profiles based on early results
M1197 must not run candidate replay
M1197 must not add hidden or oracle actor inputs
M1197 must not claim profile superiority or driver performance
forbidden_shortcuts: do not change generated configs per profile after seeing results
do not run public proof replay as if this were a driver candidate
do not compare performance except as smoke diagnostics
do not add hidden or oracle actor inputs
do not skip recording failed profiles

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_training_plumbing: bounded Stage B all-profile train-loop smoke
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: tests whether all eight generated L0/L1/L2/L3 profiles can complete identical smoke-scale training loops
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: training plumbing smoke only; no promotion private-holdout driver-performance recurrent-belief profile-superiority or paper-result claim
stop_condition: stop if any generated profile fails to complete
stop if any run produces non-finite metrics
stop if L2_window_100 exceeds resource cap
stop if L3_reset_control reset semantics are not executable
fallback_plan: if L2_window_100 fails due resource, route to finite-window resource audit
if L3_reset_control fails, route to reset-control implementation repair
if all pass, route to fair comparison pilot design
if only Stage A repeats pass, keep Stage B blocked and do not compare profiles
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1196 Stage A training smoke passed and Stage B full generated-profile smoke is the next plumbing gate

training_stage.stage_objective: bounded profile training smoke Stage B
admission_evidence: M1196 representative Stage A profile training smoke passes
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, review, and next manifest
next_stage_criteria: next fair comparison pilot design or repair milestone is selected

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1197 is train-loop plumbing and does not test history necessity.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1197 trains all profile windows but does not evaluate temporal evidence.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If a profile fails, record it as training plumbing evidence and route to focused repair without comparing performance.
allowed_claims: Stage B training-loop smoke readiness or failure
no self-identification, driver capability, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: All eight generated L0/L1/L2/L3 profiles can complete identical smoke-scale PPO training loops after Stage A passes.
success_criteria: all eight generated profile runs complete
summary reports no private holdout no promotion no candidate replay no actor-input expansion
no profile superiority or driver-performance claim occurs

hidden or oracle actor inputs are introduced
results are framed as profile superiority
